name: Software outsourcing revenue
question: Are companies still paying others to build software?
metric: Combined annual revenue of Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, EPAM and Globant, latest full year
solvedIf: Revenue falls because companies no longer hire people to build software
trendLabel: Combined annual revenue of five public outsourcing companies, in billions of dollars.
caution: AI can also help these firms, because companies may pay them to adopt it. Revenue can also hold up while staff numbers fall.
Accenture is the largest here and is mostly consulting, not software. Acquisitions can add revenue and staff, and fiscal years differ by company.
rule: Still growing when combined revenue is higher than the year before.

analysis.title: Revenue per employee
analysis.intro: These firms charge for people, so this shows whether revenue is separating from headcount. From 2023 to 2025, it moved +6%.
points: Revenue per employee went from $72K to $76K.
Revenue moved +9% and employees +3% over the same period.

scoreReason: After inflation: Up 4% since ChatGPT launched.
